account_disconnected_notice: Last.fm disconnected and private plugin data cleared.
account_libraries_allowlist: The server allows scrobbling only from selected libraries. You may exclude additional libraries.
account_libraries_blocklist: The server blocks scrobbling from certain libraries. You may exclude additional libraries.
account_libraries_select: Select which libraries scrobble to your Last.fm account:
account_no_libraries: No music libraries found on this server.
account_refusal_admin: Last.fm sign-in could not start. The server names {named} as the return address, but this page expects {expected}. Set the published server address (start option published-server-url) to the address users open, or add the proxy under Networking, Known proxies. Then restart Jellyfin.
account_refusal_user: Last.fm sign-in could not start. Ask the administrator of this server to check the server address setting.
account_unconfirmed: Last.fm did not confirm the connection. Start again.
admin_add_app_before_connecting: Add a Last.fm application under Advanced before connecting.
admin_advanced_desc: Release builds include the project's Last.fm application, so most servers need nothing here. A server may use its own application instead; it is stored protected on this server and never shown again.
admin_all_artists_desc: A track with several artists is sent as "A, B & C" instead of under its first artist. Last.fm keeps that credit as an artist of its own.
admin_app_status_none: No Last.fm application is available on this server.
admin_app_status_override: In use: an application override stored on this server. Connected accounts must connect again after a change.
admin_app_status_project: In use: the Last.fm application included with this build.
admin_app_status_unreadable: Not in use: the application override stored on this server cannot be read with its keys, as after a restore without them. Enter the application again or remove the override.
admin_block_rules_desc: Never scrobble or send now playing for items matching any rule.
admin_cleanup_rules_desc: Clean track metadata before scrobbling and now playing. Rules apply in order.
admin_confirm_remove_desc: Remove the application override stored on this server? The server then uses the application included with this build, if there is one. Connected accounts must connect again.
admin_connect_from_dashboard: Connect from the music dashboard of this server.
admin_connection_load_failed: The Last.fm connection could not be loaded.
admin_connection_not_confirmed: Last.fm did not confirm the connection. Start again.
admin_connection_refused_start_again: Last.fm did not connect. Start again.
admin_override_remove_failed: The application override could not be removed.
admin_override_save_failed: The application override could not be saved.
admin_reconnect_required: . Last.fm asks you to connect again.
admin_remove_featured_desc: Trailing featured credits such as "(feat. B)", "[feat. B]", "feat. B" or "- feat. B" are removed from track titles and artists before scrobbling and now playing.
admin_require_musicbrainz: Scrobble only tracks with a MusicBrainz recording ID
admin_require_musicbrainz_desc: Tracks without a valid MusicBrainz recording ID are skipped and neither scrobbled nor sent as now playing.
admin_signin_refusal_return_address: The server names {named} as the return address, but this page expects {expected}. Set the published server address (start option published-server-url) to the address users open, or add the proxy under Networking, Known proxies. Then restart Jellyfin.
admin_signin_refused_http: The server refused the request (HTTP {status}); the server log names the reason.
admin_threshold_desc: Last.fm counts a track longer than 30 seconds once half of it or 4 minutes, whichever comes first, has been heard. These settings can only make that stricter.
admin_threshold_percent: Share of the track to hear (percent, 50 to 100)
admin_user_connect_intro: Each user connects their own Last.fm account. Other users do so from the music dashboard:
app_connection_failed_retry: Last.fm did not connect. Start again.
app_delivery_clock_skew: Last.fm found a play time ahead of its clock; retrying automatically
app_delivery_daily_limit: Last.fm daily limit reached; submissions retained
app_delivery_held_play: Oldest held play is {days} days old; Last.fm drops plays it finds too old
app_delivery_legacy_plugin: Remove the legacy plugin to enable delivery
app_delivery_pending_persistence: {pending} still waiting for storage; these listens cannot yet survive a server restart
app_delivery_rate_limit: Last.fm rate limit reached; submissions retained
app_delivery_unwritten_events: Some playback events could not be saved; check server logs
app_failed_config_load: The plugin could not load its server configuration.
app_search_choose_seed: Choose a starting point from your library.
app_search_no_matches: No matching tracks or artists in your library.
app_search_placeholder_min: Enter at least two characters to search.
common_footer_terms: . Music data remains subject to Last.fm's terms.
connection_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Last.fm and clear your plugin history, pending submissions and preferences? Your Last.fm account and Jellyfin library will remain.
connection_scrobble_log_desc: Local export of your scrobbles as JSON or CSV.
discovery_desc: Explore your own library and discover music beyond it.
discovery_search_label: Start from a track or artist (optional)
favourites_desc: Merge existing favourites and sync additions both ways. Removals wait for your review.
favourites_running: Synchronization is running on the server. Select Refresh review to see the result.
history_import_applied_partial: {applied} of {matched} tracks already applied. This confirmed import can be resumed.
history_import_continue_notice: Continue gathering play counts and verified last-played dates before confirming this import.
history_import_desc: Preview the changes first. Imports keep the higher play count and later verified play date; they never add the two totals together.
history_import_higher_counts_notice: Counts use the higher total, not a sum. Separate listening histories may be undercounted.
history_import_no_preview: No saved preview. Prepare a new preview to import history.
history_import_partial: {applied} of {total} tracks applied. Progress saved; continue the confirmed import when ready.
history_import_preview_complete: {applied} previewed tracks imported. Existing higher counts and later dates were retained.
history_import_review_notice: Review the play-count changes before importing.
open_in_jellyfin_desc: Manage your Last.fm connection directly inside the Jellyfin web client.
overview_desc: Your Last.fm listening statistics, all in one place.
playlists_cancellation_confirm: Cancel this update and pause its daily refresh? The Jellyfin playlist will remain in its current, possibly partial state.
playlists_desc: Generated playlists are private. Regeneration replaces their tracks; make a copy in Jellyfin to keep your own edits.
playlists_empty: Create a playlist to get started.
playlists_pending_cancelled: Pending update cancelled. The playlist was kept and daily refresh paused.
playlists_rotate_label: Rotate: keep tracks out for N days
playlists_stop_notice: Automatic management stopped. The Jellyfin playlist was kept.
rules_load_media_types_failed: Could not load media type settings.
rules_load_scrobble_log_failed: Could not load scrobble log settings.
rules_no_devices: No devices found for your account.
rules_select_devices: Select which devices scrobble to your Last.fm account:
rules_select_media_types: Select which media types scrobble to your Last.fm account:
client_empty_response: The server returned an empty response.
client_response_too_large: The server response is too large.
client_response_too_deep: The server response is too deeply nested.
client_base_path_invalid: The server base path is invalid.
client_invalid_session: The server returned an invalid sign-in session.
client_signed_out_unconfirmed: Signed out of this page. Jellyfin could not confirm server-session revocation.
client_session_expired: Your Jellyfin session expired. Sign in again.
client_forbidden: Your account cannot perform this action.
client_storage_full: JellySin reached its data storage limit. Any saved progress is retained; check storage before retrying.
client_unavailable_or_expired: This action is unavailable or its preview expired. Refresh and try again.
client_application_missing: This server has no usable Last.fm application. Ask a server administrator.
client_request_failed: The request could not be completed (HTTP {status}).
client_download_failed: The download could not be completed (HTTP {status}).
